svg.text: GDP per head, PPP, current international dollars (log scale)
Line: least squares on log income, 7.7 points per natural-log unit, R² 0.51
Labeled: the 6 largest residuals above the line and the 6 largest below it
Scores as of 2026-10-02. GDP: World Bank WDI NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.CD, latest year per country (2022 to 2024). Not in the World Bank data (10): Taiwan,
Liechtenstein, Monaco, Vatican City, Cuba, Venezuela, South Sudan, Yemen, Eritrea, North Korea. Source: Health Record Rights Index, SuperTruth;
